book.name: Yoan
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Yoan byex o

content: Ekom Yesu la lukendu Oliv.
Ka satiboukeing lul eno moxo lox me la tete lalei wei xomek vambuing o no, me xomaxoneing qekuma vivekwou e, de moxo dei me di teyoxe xel.
De xel putoung wei petieing o me xel Parisi yei vex wei mi wong kwapesiv o ti me qou me lam. Xel wong vexo nale wou xomaxoneing wei toundei eivek qendu yon mend
me neil wou Yesu, “Putoung, xa xei vex tine wo kwapesiv.
Eivek petieing eno Mose neil embei xey a banex vex ambei nye en qakous me e mey. Wambei neil vati?”
Xel wong telinyeing tiyon wou e nambei lepulek, en xel di yimexe qes wei xel embei bong qayeeng en e yo. Ekom Yesu dundek me di byex lek tembuing en mema deyis.
Xel di embek teling e ngenong om moxo nale ghey me neil wou xel, “Wangwei xelti se mi bong sewokeing nei ond e banex vexo en qakous atax.”
Moxo lox me la dundek no me di byex lek tembuing.
Xel ngo qayeeng on eno xel titi la veil inyon xel wei vakovek qes ngenong eno la tax de xel valu la yus. Dom Yesu venaxow toundei de vex on toukale inyon.
Yesu nale ghey me teling wou vexo bei, “Vex, xel la inya? Beip xelti se toundei bei bo qayeeng en wang?”
Vexo neil embei, “Ma, teiv, xelti se toundei.” Woyom Yesu neilteyei bei, “Ay is ambei nyon a se wo qayeeng en wang. La de wa seng nox me na bong sewokeing no.”
Yesu e xeiyaing wei tembuing o
Yesu lox me la luk wou xomaxoneing no, eno moxo neil embei, “A xeiyaing wei tembuing o. Xelti embei betiwou ay eno tyek se teyei bei na eivek mapetok, qe tyek na qou xeiyaing wei mapieing o.”
Xel Parisi neil wou moxo bei, “Wang mi neil xuk me kwa wei wamaxow o teyei, om qayeeng wei wang on se neing.”

Yesu lewexe bei, “Ee, a neil lulti beimambei ne lek venaxow, a xe qayeeng ne neing, en a woulek ingwei a lam anghei yo de ingwei ambei na yo. Ekom xam seng woulek ingwei a lam anghei yo me ingwei ambei na yo.
Xam ghe mi wo qayeeng en kwa wei xomaxoneing o, a se mi wo qayeeng en xelti.
Ekom wangwei ambei bo qayeeng en xelti, ond a xe qayeeng on zonghek, en nambei se a maxow, qe a mi nale is Mang, tiwei wong a lam o.
Eivek xam venaxow xe petieing eno xel byex ambei nye, wangwei tambiy yayuw embei neil qayeeng teyeima ond luw xe qayeeng on zonghek.
A maxow a mi neil qayeeng en venaxow, de tiwei mi yeimawou yo eno inye Mang tiwei wong a lam o.”
Woyom xel teling moxo, “Wa mam inya?” Yesu neil elox bei, “Xam seng woulek a Mang. Wangwei xam ghe boulek ay on tyek xam ghe boulek Mang is ambei nyon.”
Moxo neil qayeeng tine gyeik di teyoxe xel eivek tete lalei wei xomek vambuing o paviy ingwei xel mi toung da eivek o. Ekom xelti se zeimaxoun e en nambei e xe bouk seng ghei lam.
Yesu neil embei tyek xam seng nam ingwei ambei na yo
Yesu neil no wou xel, “A la, dom tyek xam seng gwei ay, de tyek xam amey eivek sewokeing wei xam o. De ingwei ambei na nei eno tyek xam seng nam.”
Qayeeng tiyon wong Yudayeiw teling wouma bei, “Tyek moxo nyeis venaxow amey? Om neil embei, ‘Ingwei ambei na eno xam seng teyei bei nam’?”
Ekom Yesu tetulexe bei, “Xam on anghei nge xone de ay anghei nge gheyapu. Xam anghei tembuing de a se nanghei tembuing ne.
A neil wou xam woy bei tyek xam amey eivek xam xe sewokeing, wangwei xam seng bongis bei A Maxow Mindei Bei Nye, on tyek xam amey eivek sewokeing wei xam o.”
Xel teling, “Wang eti?” Yesu neil elox bei, “Kayon a neil wou xam myaxeeng eno.

A xe qayeeng ngenong di yeip en ingwei ambei neil me na bong qayeeng en xam o. Ekom tambiy tiwei wong a lam eno e xe kwa yon zonghek, yom vati wei a ngo wou e eno a neil wou xomaxoneing wei tembuing sapa yo.”
Xel se woulek ingwei Yesu di neil wou xel en Ma yo.

Om Yesu neil embei, “Gyeik ingwei xam a zeim Xomaxoneing Neu Moux zekna, woyom tyek xam ghe boulek bei A maxow a mindei bei nye de a se mi wong lulti nangya kwang, qe a mi neil qayeeng nambei kawei Mang teyoxe wou ay yo.
Tambiy tiwei wong a lam eno mindei is ay, moxo se mi saing ay de a maxow a mindei, en a mi wong vatiyeiw wei e lalei vind o.”
Xomaxoneing ngo ingwei moxo neil ambei nyon, eno xel ngenong wongis e.
Apraham neuyeiw la vevopeing
Yesu neil wou Yudayeiw wei wongis e yo bei, “Wangwei xam a zeimaxoun a xe qayeeng teyoxeing, ond neing ayang xam on a xe betiyeing.
Woyom tyek xam ghe boulek qayeeng zonghek, de qayeeng zonghek na tul xam ghe na nivax.”
Xel lewexe lek e bei, “Xa ne Apraham neumambu, xa se xukxe bandaing wei xelti yo. Nambei nya wang neimbei tyek xa na nivax?”
Yesu neil elox bei, “A neil zonghek wou xam, xel sapa wei mi wong sewokeing eno xel on xukxe bandaing wei sewokeing o.
Xukxe bandaing ti se mindei is mamata me neuyeiw takwei takwei qe neu mindei takwei takwei.
Om wangwei Neu Moux na tul xam ghe na nivax, ond xam ghe la nivax zonghek.
A woulek bei xam on velei wei Apraham o, ekom xam a being nyeis a mey, en nambei a xe qayeeng se yeip eivek xam laleimim.
A mi neil wou xam en vati wei a xei lam wou Mang o, de xam ghe mi wong vati wei xam ghe ngo wou xam mamim.”
Xel lewexe bei, “Apraham on xa mami.” Yesu neil embei, “Wangwei Apraham neuyeiw xam, woyom tyek xam ghe bong lul wei Apraham mi wong o.
A tambiy tiwei a mi neil qayeeng zonghek wei a ngo wou Anutu yo, ekom xam a being nyeis a mey. Apraham se mi wong kwa nambei nyon.
Xam ghe mi wong lulul wei xam venaxow mamim mi wong o.” Xel neil embei, “Xa tamiyeiw se wo kwapesiv me wou xa ti, qe Mang tixemou wei xa xe eno Anutu venaxow.”
Yesu neil wou xel, “Wangwei Anutu yon xam Mamim, on tyek xam laleimim devind ay, en a toundei is Anutu me na lam. A lam inye. A se lam angya a maxow kwang, qe moxo wong a lam.
Nambei nya a xe qayeeng se yeip yaing wou xam? En qes ambei nye xam seng teyei bei ngo vati wei a neil o.

Xam mamim on Sandang, me xam ambei mi bong kwa wei xam mamim mi wong o. Myaxeeng eno moxo mi leis xel mey, se mi zeim qayeeng zonghek, en inyei qayeeng zonghek se toundei eivek e. De mi neil qayeeng tyonyeing en inyon emaxow tyonyeing qes, en moxo tyonyeingana me wo ma en tyonyeing.
En nambei a mi neil qayeeng zonghek, ekom xam seng mi wongis ay!
Xel wei xam on valu yei bei a wong sewokeing? Wangwei a mi neil qayeeng zonghek, ond nambei nya xam seng wongis ay?
Tambiy tiwei Anutu xe eno mi ngo vati wei Anutu mi neil o. Xam on Anutu se xe en qes bei xam seng mi ngo vati wei e mi neil o.”
Yesu lei ngandoung ghanaw Apraham
Yudayeiw lewexe wou moxo bei, “Xa neil neing en ingwei xa neimbei wa Samaria ti om memo ti nale eivek wang?”
Yesu neil embei, “Memo ti se toungale eivek ay ti, qe a mi sanghoxe mang lei de xam ghe mi beoux ay.
A se di ximexe lei ngandoung wei a maxow o. Qe inyei xelti di yimexe, de moxo inye tambiy wei mi ngo qayeeng o.
Neing ayang a neil wou xam, wangwei xelti embei betiwou a xe qayeeng on tyek se teyei bei daxe meyeing.”

En tiyon eno xel Yudayeiw neil embei, “Gweimbeeng xa woulek bei memo dei eivek wang! Apraham mey me xel poropet is ambei nyon, de wang neimbei xelti embei betiwou wa xe qayeeng on tyek se teyei bei daxe meyeing.
Wang ghanaw xe mend Apraham? Moxo mey, me xel poropet is. Wang wou naleim bei wang eti?”
Yesu neil elox bei, “Wangwei a sanghoxe a maxow leing ond a leing on bandaing. Mang tiwei xam ghe neimbei xam xe Anutu eno mi sanghoxe a leing.
Xam seng woulek e, qe a woulek e. Wangwei a neimbei a se woulek e on a wo tyonyeing ambei xam, ekom a woulek e me na mi betiwou e xe qayeeng.
Xam bumim Apraham wo xeilala en embei gyei a xe bouk, moxo yei woy de wo xeilala.”
Yudayeiw neil wou moxo bei, “Wa xe vakovek qes se ghei la 50, de wang wei Apraham!”
Yesu lewexe bei, “A neil wou xam zonghek, takwei wei Apraham se ghei umbek eno A Maxow A Mindei.”
Woyom xel qou qakous en xel embei banex e, ekom Yesu xupek en xel me la myayaing veil tete wei xomek vambuing o.
